name: RDE-inspired spatial memory-value repair in frozen SAM2
status: Engineering-only design; full efficacy protocol must be frozen separately before training/evaluation
motivation: Completed fixed TRAIN-only oracle headroom: mask-only mean +0.143509 Dice on 9 eligible sequences, CI [+0.014277,+0.309267], Holm p=.078125; not a learned result or proof of novelty.

prior_work.hyperparameters: Author defaults: temperature=1, KL coefficient=10, mean reduction retained unchanged. Pin Torch version because the upstream reduction has a future-change warning.
prior_work.adaptation: Only channel KL consistency is reused. SAM2 GT source mask values are training teachers. No RDE memory fusion, learned RDE weights or benchmark scores transferred.

architecture.module: One shared author SAM2 MLP(64,128,64,2), ReLU, zero-initialized final linear layer, residual on unpositioned spatial values before frozen v_proj in all four layers. 16,576 trainable parameters.
architecture.reuse: SAM2 sam2/modeling/sam2_utils.py::MLP unchanged, except zero initialization of final layer in wrapper
architecture.shared: Same 64-channel bank representation enters each layer, so use one repair function; no claim that four independent heads are needed.
architecture.inference: Only native token feature vectors enter the MLP; no GT, region category, confidence gate, threshold-based selection or frame selection. Learned changes may alter later-layer queries and future masks; do not claim unchanged attention maps.

proposed_comparison.C1: Identical value MLP trained with segmentation/object-presence losses only
proposed_comparison.C2: Same MLP, initialization, samples, optimizer and training budget plus pinned RDE channel KL to GT-mask source values retaining native source presence
proposed_comparison.data: Keep existing TRAIN seq2-6,8-12; validation seq13-15; historical test seq16-23 is previously analysed and not independent confirmation. No validation/test access during engineering. Full schedule/stopping rules remain to be finalized and frozen before efficacy.

fixtures: PolypGen seq2, seq3 fixed 9-frame prefixes, query8 full 28672 spatial keys
DAVIS bike-packing persistent indexed IDs 1 and 2, order/isolation checks before efficacy
required: all four layers and full memory spans
conditioning frame/pointer preservation after nonzero training
finite adapter gradients, unchanged SAM2 weights
upstream loss numerical agreement and detached teacher
exact optimizer/RNG/bank save-resume replay including fresh process
engineering.scope: Bounded tests are engineering only; no efficacy result or deployment claim.
